newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-JOHN BARNARD JOINS ARROWS AS TECHNICAL DIRECTOR.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-JOHN BARNARD JOINS ARROWS AS TECHNICAL DIRECTOR.

text.p: The Arrows Formula One motor racing team said on Tuesday that top British designer John Barnard had joined them as technical director.
Barnard, 51, has been linked with Arrows since his five-year association with Ferrari ended earlier this season. He will replace Briton Frank Dernie, who has left the team.
